modules.title: Introduction to Python
modules.description: Learn the fundamentals of Python programming including syntax, variables, and basic data types.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its readability and versatility. It is widely used in education, web development, data science, and automation.
sections.code:
# Your first Python program
print('Hello, World!')

sections.heading: Why Python?
sections.body: Python's simple syntax makes it ideal for beginners. It runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux without modification.

sections.heading: Variables
sections.body: Variables store data values. In Python, you create a variable by assigning a value using the equals sign.

sections.heading: Data Types
sections.body: Python has several built-in data types: strings (str), integers (int), floats (float), and booleans (bool).

sections.heading: The print() Function
sections.body: Use print() to display output to the console.

sections.heading: The input() Function
sections.body: Use input() to receive text from the user.

modules.title: Control Structures
modules.description: Master conditional statements and loops to control program flow.

sections.heading: Conditional Logic
sections.body: If-else statements let your program make decisions based on conditions.

sections.heading: For Loops
sections.body: For loops iterate over sequences like lists and ranges.

sections.heading: While Loops
sections.body: While loops repeat as long as a condition is true.
